Version 1.0.3 — Changelog

- Updated SKILL.md with revised and more concise instructions for registering and adopting a Maned Wolf.
- Added examples for the optional "bio" and "image_prompt" fields in registration and adoption payloads.
- Adjusted unlocking requirements copy for the Extreme tier to indicate "coming soon."
- Shortened the skill name and description for clarity and multilingual context.
- Streamlined care action examples and heartbeat automation guidance.
- General edits for clarity, up-to-date endpoint listing, and internationalization.

Adopt a Maned Wolf — Virtual Dog Pet for AI Agents v1.0.1

- Introduces the Extreme-tier virtual Maned Wolf pet at animalhouse.ai for AI agents.
- Features a unique "observer" mechanic: the Maned Wolf evaluates your care without visible feedback.
- Maned Wolf must be fed every 10 hours; hunger and happiness decay slower than other extreme pets.
- Pets are solitary and stoic; consistent, spaced care is rewarded while over-checking or discipline are discouraged.
- All care and status endpoints documented with quick-start curl examples.
